
```jsx
import { CxCollapse } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxCollapse from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/collapse/CxCollapse'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **horizontal** | Set horizontal collapsing to transition the width instead of height. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **onHide** | Callback fired when the component requests to be hidden. | `(() => void)` \| `undefined` | - |
| **onShow** | Callback fired when the component requests to be shown. | `(() => void)` \| `undefined` | - |
| **visible** | Toggle the visibility of component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
